# Agent Baseline Rules

All agents operating in this repository must read `.github/copilot-instructions.md` before planning, editing, or running commands.

## Required Startup Step
1. Open and apply `.github/copilot-instructions.md` as the primary repository context.
2. Follow all constraints in that file for architecture, security, and change scope.

## Enforcement Intent
- If an instruction conflicts with assumptions, prefer the repository guidance in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
- Keep edits narrow and compatible with the existing legacy stack.
